scope: Meaning of same logical graph/kernel descriptors at140; no frozen plan edits or added execution.
rule: The two independently constructed solvers have separate buffer, module/function, graph and event handles. Raw descriptor or pointer-byte equality across arms is invalid.
bounded_check: Use reusable node cardinality/kind comparison and kernel grid/block/shared-memory launch shapes.
Resolve each arm's function handle only against its own already-known kernel-function handles, then compare the resulting logical kernel identities.
Do not compare cross-arm handle values, CUDA_KERNEL_NODE_PARAMS pointer-bearing struct bytes, raw argument storage or unknown-size pointed memory. No new general pointer-normalization framework.
Perform any descriptor inspection at the post-completion140 checkpoint, outside sampled batch scheduling; no graph edits, extra replay, warm or capture.
primary_evidence: Byte-unchanged production queue/evaluation code, normal warm/capture cadence, immutable exploit anchors and matched defined post-evaluation state remain the primary equivalence evidence. Metadata inspection is a bounded secondary check.
